objective: Independently verify that the exact M461 prereview R2 closure closes every P1/P2 from the prior independent hammer without changing architecture priority or claim boundary. The maximum allowed decision is future M461 contract/event-model GO; RTL and all performance claims remain forbidden.
mandatory_independent_checks: 48-bit descriptor field sum equals 48 and two 3000-row banks equal 36000 bytes; 64-bit sensitivity equals 48000 bytes
full-3000 and empty phase sentinel/valid behavior is unambiguous and fail-closed
valid, reserved, distance and use_pwp fields cannot create an illegal PWP read or stale replay
center-to-compact remap is injective, contiguous over used centers, invertible for audit, and unknown/invalid lookup fails closed
assignment seal, phase epoch, bank role switch and drain rules exclude cross-phase reuse or premature replay
standard nearest-rank p95 is 1584 while the frozen legacy floor-index value is 1576 and neither is silently relabeled
B shared-config lower bound is 156896 bytes and replicated-config sensitivity is 157472 bytes
all prior P1/P2 findings are explicitly closed
compact original-order remains the unique first point; A/B/C/group-replay/fold priorities do not drift
claim boundary remains future contract/event-model only
mandatory_attacks: valid=0 descriptor tries to issue PWP
unknown remap entry, duplicate compact slot, non-contiguous slot or inverse mismatch
empty phase stale epoch/assignment/PWP state reuse
full 3000-row phase encodes sentinel as a legal row and loses one row
role switch before assignment/PWP seal or before generator/fold drain
B silently switches between shared and replicated config
R2 closure upgrades RTL or performance admission
forbidden_inputs_and_actions: any RTL read, edit, launch or authorization
any performance, cycle, energy, power, PPA or DATE-headline admission

scoring.P0: identity/seal failure, P1/P2 not closed, protocol/remap fail-open, priority/claim drift, or forbidden input/action
scoring.P1: closure remains ambiguous enough to change future capacity/protocol admission
